result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect in the bottom navigation bar: a stray horizontal line/strikethrough is drawn across the search and orders icons, which looks like a rendering artifact. Additionally, the bottom navigation icons appear vertically clipped and lack labels, reducing clarity.

issues.description: A stray horizontal line is rendered across the bottom navigation bar, striking through the search (magnifier) icon and extending to the orders (receipt) icon. It looks like a broken divider or misplaced border element rather than intentional design.
issues.suggestion: Remove or reposition the errant line/border element so the navigation icons render cleanly without a strikethrough.

issues.description: The bottom navigation icons appear vertically clipped at the bottom edge of the bar, with no visible labels or safe-area padding beneath them.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding / safe-area inset to the navigation bar so icons are fully visible and vertically centered; consider adding text labels for clarity and accessibility.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, which can make their purpose ambiguous (especially the receipt/orders icon) and reduces accessibility for screen reader and low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Add short text labels under each nav icon (e.g., Home, Search, Orders, Profile) or at minimum ensure accessible labels are provided.
